I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random: "Thanks, Ilse. Noted: Tamsyn Halvorsen is the main contact for the Moorland rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines. I won't do anything until you tell me to."

She said there was nothing to do yet, so I didn't send any mail or messages and didn't look anything up.
